name: RK AI Post Reader
author: rohan002

sections.description:
RK AI Post Reader allows your readers to quickly summarize long articles and listen to them. It uses the Gemini AI API for high-quality summaries and native browser synthesis for text-to-speech.

Features:
* Auto-adds to all blog posts.
* Shortcode [rk_ai_reader] for use on specific Pages.
* Multi-language support (English, Hindi, Nepali).
* Modern glassmorphism UI.

External Services

This plugin relies on the Google Gemini AI service to generate content summaries.

  • Service: Google Gemini API (https://aistudio.google.com/)
  • Data Sent: This plugin sends the text content of the current post to Google’s API when the user triggers the “Summarize” action. No personal user data or IP addresses are sent by the plugin code.
  • Privacy & Terms: The use of this service is governed by Google’s Privacy Policy and the Google Generative AI Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rk-ai-post-reader folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > RK AI Reader and enter your Gemini API Key.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API Key?

You can get a free key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

Does it support Nepali?

Yes! It provides summaries in Nepali and uses Devanagari-compatible voice engines for reading.
